note: BH-9937 (BH-9926 wave 5): settings row lane.pr-state-reconcile.gh_source. Where the sweep reads each repo's open PR list and a closed PR's state: off = GitHub only (today's reads); shadow (default) = the PR record and GitHub, the lane acts on GitHub and logs one PRR_SHADOW line in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ; record = the PR record (a miss reads GitHub and logs PRR_MISS) plus the per-PR wake gate bin/lib/prr-seen.sh: a PR with no wake since its last read makes 0 GitHub reads. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. Read once per sweep by prr_step in bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh. Move to record only after a 48-hour shadow count of 0 (docs/notes/2026-11-25-BH-9937-lanes-record-read.md).
